- Git worktree already has Ralph/task planning changes and current task files; treat them as existing task state and preserve them.
- Next: inspect config/API/client/startup/stateoperator code and implement plan with focused red-green slices.

- Completed config TDD slice.
- Added TestLoadNSXWritesEnabledDefaultsTrueAndAllowsFalse, confirmed RED because config.NSXConfig had no WritesEnabled field.
- Implemented nsx.writesEnabled parsing with default true and explicit false support.
- Focused verification passed: go test ./internal/config -run TestLoadNSXWritesEnabledDefaultsTrueAndAllowsFalse -count=1.
- Next: API/CRD writesEnabled field and focused CRD behavior.

- Completed API/CRD TDD slice.
- Added API tests for NSXNetworkCloudSpec writesEnabled default semantics and deep-copy independence; confirmed RED on missing field/helper.
- Added spec.writesEnabled *bool, NSXWritesEnabled() default-true helper, and deepcopy handling.
- Added CRD envtest behavior for storing false and rejecting non-boolean writesEnabled; confirmed RED because schema dropped unknown field.
- Updated config/crd/bases/nsx.ing.com_nsxnetworkclouds.yaml with spec.writesEnabled boolean default true and printer column.
- Focused verification passed: go test ./api/v1alpha -run 'TestNetworkCloudSpecWritesEnabledDefaultsTrueAndAllowsFalse|TestDeepCopyObjectKeepsNetworkCloudAndGroupIndependent' -count=1 and envtest CRD focused command with KUBEBUILDER_ASSETS.
- Next: nsxclient write gate sentinel error, structured zap info log, and blocked write/non-reachability tests.

- Completed nsxclient/startup/stateoperator write-gate implementation slices.
- Added client-boundary WriteControl and WriteDisabledError; focused nsxclient tests prove POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE are blocked before transport and GET/list still reach transport, with structured zap fields.
- Added startup writeControlForCloud with global override/per-cloud disable behavior and normalized NetworkCloud context.
- Added stateoperator classification for WriteDisabledError in manage apply/delete status conditions.
- Updated ApplyManagerPlan so WriteDisabledError stops remaining NSX writes but still applies Kubernetes statuses/cloud status.
- Added mock API-backed recorder test proving disabled writes do not reach ../nsx-t-mockapi-equivalent recorder and GET list still does.
- Added config default preservation for programmatic zero-value NSXConfig using WritesEnabledConfigured; YAML-loaded configs set it true.
- Next: run broader package tests, inspect boundary cleanliness, update task evidence, then required make check/test/coverage/test-contract.

- Impacted package verification passed with envtest assets: KUBEBUILDER_ASSETS=$(./.bin/setup-envtest use 1.32.x -p path) go test ./internal/config ./api/v1alpha ./internal/nsxclient ./internal/startup ./internal/stateoperator -count=1.
- make -n shows make check runs gofumpt, go vet, golangci-lint, go test ./..., race tests, contract tests, focused envtest/e2e, and largechaos; make test runs envtest go test ./...; make test-coverage enforces total coverage >=80%.
- Next: run make check, make test, make test-coverage, and explicit make test-contract; then record evidence and finalize task if all pass.

- Final verification passed: make check, make test, make test-contract, and make test-coverage all pass on the final tree.
- make test-coverage reports total coverage 83.4%; new write-control functions inspected with go tool cover are at 100% for NSXWritesEnabled, requireWriteEnabled, requestURL, writeControlForCloud, isWriteDisabled, and writeDisabledConfigName.
- Updated task file status to done, passes true, checked all acceptance criteria, and recorded detailed verification evidence.
- Next: run .ralph/task_switch.sh, then git add all files, commit with required message, push, and quit immediately.
